Runtime dependencies kept locally so the 3D scene does not depend on CDN availability.

- Three.js r128: https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/three.js/r128/three.min.js
- GSAP 3.12.5: https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/gsap/3.12.5/gsap.min.js

Original bundled license notices are preserved in both files. These are the same versions previously loaded remotely by the project.
